name: Occupational health screening
purpose: Assess fitness for a safety-critical role
dpia_message: Article 35 requires a DPIA before this special category processing. A DPIA is recorded as completed. This check does not generate the DPIA.

evidence.description: The purpose is health or social care as described in Article 9(2)(h).
Article 9(3): processing is by, or under the responsibility of, a person subject to professional secrecy.
Processing rests on UK law or a contract with a health professional.
